claim.claim-text: 1. A method for determining a position and orientation of at least one camera of a camera assembly (350) comprising a plurality of cameras (351, 352, 353, 354) directed to respective imaging directions, using another camera of the camera assembly (350), wherein the relative position and orientation between each of the cameras (351, 352, 353, 354) is known, the method comprising the procedures of:

capturing at least one image of a scene (340) with a first camera (354) of the camera assembly (350), and determining the 3D position and orientation coordinates of the first camera (354) by georegistering the captured image to a 3D geographic model; determining 3D position and orientation coordinates of at least a second camera (353) of the camera assembly (350), based on the determined global position and orientation of the first camera (354), and the relative position and orientation (358) of the second camera (353) relative to the first camera (354).
2. The method of claim 1, wherein the second camera (353) comprises at least one imaging characteristic which is limited relative to the first camera (354).

3. The method of claim 1, further comprising the procedure of assigning a ranking to each camera (351, 352, 353, 354) of the camera assembly (350) based on the respective imaging characteristics thereof, and selecting the first camera (354), for determining position and orientation thereof by georegistration to a 3D geographic model, in accordance with the assigned rankings.

4. A system for determining a position and orientation of at least one camera of a camera assembly (350) comprising a plurality of cameras (351, 352, 353, 354) directed to respective imaging directions, using another camera of the camera assembly (350), the system comprising:

a camera assembly (350) comprising a plurality of cameras (351, 352, 353, 354) directed to respective imaging directions, wherein the relative position and orientation between each of the cameras (351, 352, 353, 354) is known; and a processor, coupled with the camera assembly (350), wherein the processor is configured to receive at least one image of a scene (340) captured by a first camera (354) of the camera assembly (350), and to determine the 3D position and orientation coordinates of the first camera (354) by georegistering the captured image to a 3D geographic model, and further configured to determine 3D position and orientation coordinates of at least a second camera (353) of the camera assembly (350), based on the determined 3D position and orientation of the first camera (354), and the relative position and orientation (358) of the second camera (353) relative to the first camera (354).
5. The system of claim 4, wherein the second camera (353) comprises at least one imaging characteristic which is limited relative to the first camera (354).
6. The system of claim 4, wherein the camera assembly (350) is mounted on a platform.

7. The system of claim 4, wherein the processor is further configured to assign a ranking to each camera (351, 352, 353, 354) of the camera assembly (350) based on the respective imaging characteristics thereof, and to select the first camera (354), for determining position and orientation thereof by georegistration to a 3D geographic model, in accordance with the assigned rankings.
